     6→import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
     7→import io.mockk.every
     8→import io.mockk.mockk
     9→import io.mockk.slot
    10→import io.mockk.verify
    11→import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
    12→import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations
    13→
    14→class MallValkeyRepositoryUnitTest : FunSpec({
    15→
    16→    val redisTemplate = mockk<RedisTemplate<String, String>>()
    17→    val valueOps = mockk<ValueOperations<String, String>>(relaxed = true)
    18→    val repository = MallValkeyRepository(redisTemplate)
    19→
    20→    beforeEach {
    21→        every { redisTemplate.opsForValue() } returns valueOps
    22→    }
    23→
    24→    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하는 몰을 조회하면 엔티티 리스트를 반환한다") {
    25→        val mall1 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")
    26→        val mall2 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 2, mallCode = "M002", mallIdDanawa = "D002")
    27→
    28→        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
    29→            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall1),
    30→            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall2),
    31→        )
    32→
    33→        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1, 2))
    34→
    35→        result.size shouldBe 2
    36→        result[0]?.mallId shouldBe 1
    37→        result[0]?.mallCode shouldBe "M001"
    38→        result[1]?.mallId shouldBe 2
    39→        result[1]?.mallIdDanawa shouldBe "D002"
    40→    }
    41→
    42→    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하지 않는 키는 null로 반환한다") {
    43→        val mall = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")
    44→
    45→        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
    46→            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall),
    47→            null,
    48→        )
    49→
    50→        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1, 999))
    51→
    52→        result.size shouldBe 2
    53→        result[0]?.mallId shouldBe 1
    54→        result[1] shouldBe null
    55→    }
    56→
    57→    test("getAllByIds - 빈 리스트를 조회하면 빈 결과를 반환한다") {
    58→        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns emptyList()
    59→
    60→        val result = repository.getAllByIds(emptyList())
    61→
    62→        result shouldBe emptyList()
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    test("setAll - 엔티티 리스트를 Valkey에 저장한다") {
    66→        val mall1 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")
    67→        val mall2 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 2, mallCode = "M002")
    68→        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()
    69→
    70→        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit
    71→
    72→        repository.setAll(listOf(mall1, mall2))
    73→
    74→        verify { valueOps.multiSet(any()) }
    75→        capturedMap.captured.size shouldBe 2
    76→        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("mall") && it.endsWith(":1") } shouldBe true
    77→        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("mall") && it.endsWith(":2") } shouldBe true
    78→    }
    79→
    80→    test("setAll - nullable 필드가 포함된 JSON이 올바르게 직렬화된다") {
    81→        val mall = MallValkeyEntity(
    82→            mallId = 42,
    83→            mallCode = "M042",
    84→            mallIdDanawa = null,
    85→            mallIdEnuri = "E042",
    86→            mallUseYnDanawa = null,
    87→            mallUseYnEnuri = "Y",
    88→        )
    89→        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()
    90→
    91→        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit
    92→
    93→        repository.setAll(listOf(mall))
    94→
    95→        val storedJson = capturedMap.captured.values.first()
    96→        val deserialized = defaultJson.decodeFromString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), storedJson)
    97→        deserialized.mallId shouldBe 42
    98→        deserialized.mallCode shouldBe "M042"
    99→        deserialized.mallIdDanawa shouldBe null
   100→        deserialized.mallIdEnuri shouldBe "E042"
   101→        deserialized.mallUseYnDanawa shouldBe null
   102→        deserialized.mallUseYnEnuri shouldBe "Y"
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    test("getKey - 올바른 키 포맷을 생성한다") {
   106→        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(null)
   107→
   108→        repository.getAllByIds(listOf(123))
   109→
   110→        val expectedKeys = listOf("commerce-search.search-api.cache.mall:123")
   111→        verify { valueOps.multiGet(expectedKeys) }
   112→    }
   113→})
